rows.rationale: KEEP: The current concise DE/EN description asks for scientific explanation of proteins/enzymes in biotechnology. It neither adds gene engineering nor assesses the preceding protein-folding/enzyme-law goals again. The two full bilingual cases and rubrics correctly distinguish lactose hydrolysis, catalytic retention and selective processing from producing protein itself. Comparative protease/human-protein roles give conceptual transfer. Broad BB/BE protein-function rows are partial contributions; direct BY C13-GA.4.12/EA.4.14 explicitly support biotechnology.

KEEP: The same criteria-based judgement applies across everyday use and nutrition. The drink calculation is20 g versus25 g, so lower concentration alone does not imply lower intake. The second complete case changes chemical function and molecular class; it is conceptual transfer, with no blanket health guarantee. German and English preserve the same scope and are usable for the effective SekI learner. Direct BY rows4e44/643399 support the stated evaluation. Unrelated raw polarimetry, structural projections or experiment duties are not imported from broad source mappings.

KEEP: Condensation representation and resonance-based geometry explain one chemical linkage competence. The full cases correctly use glycine carboxyl/alanine amino groups, leave free termini, and state that formal balance does not assert spontaneous aqueous synthesis. N-lone-pair delocalisation explains local geometry and relative rotational restriction; contributors are not alternating actual molecules. This is not a claim that every protein structure is planar. Direct BY5615 and HE Peptidbindung support the own contribution; BB/BE EPA alpha-carbon geometry and broad protein/detection duties stay separately bounded.

KEEP: The current bilingual text clearly says sugar-unit linkage, hydrolytic cleavage and structural-formula explanation. The full cases correctly distinguish maltose from sucrose linkage centres and hydrolysis from dissolution. The n-unit linear-chain transfer requires a bond count rather than a number swap. The normal display citation deduplicates HE Q2.1 B07, but raw expansion retains all four actual aspects; current7b477 contributes the glycosidic-linkage clause only. Reducing/nonreducing and iodine-starch duties remain with their broader chemistry contributors and are not declared covered by this goal.
